name: Genie-V3 static knowledge base

corpora: JulyBatch (9July / Portals / Portals TnC / LiveAll / Reported URLs)
provenance.method: Portal URLs whose registrable root differs from the org's own email domain, kept when observed for 2+ distinct institutions: 1,623 off-domain roots -> 456 multi-org -> curated here. Categories are the human-reviewed Category column (~8,900 rows).

relevance_classification_keywords._note: Categories observed in the human-reviewed Category column across ~8,900 rows. `url` matches the URL/host, `text` matches visible page text/anchor text in any language, `platform` matches vendor/product fingerprints. A URL may carry several categories (the corpus uses 'Student Portal|LMS' style compounds).

SSO.caution: A tenant SSO login IS a valid portal when it fronts student services, but a bare IdP entityID / SAML metadata URL is NEVER a portal — see compliance_exclusion_blacklist.

Fees.caution: Institution fee portals behind a student login count. Pure third-party payment/checkout GATEWAYS do not — see the blacklist (upago.cl, easebuzz, okiedokiepay).

Library.caution: The corpus DOES accept library logins as student portals (545 rows), but publisher/database SSO (Elsevier, Springer, JSTOR, EBSCO) is rejected — it is not the institution's own.

Webmail.caution: Judged 'webmail' is DROPPED by current accept rules — human review ruled staff/generic mail is not a student portal. Kept here for classification, not for acceptance.

Admissions/Application.caution: ALWAYS excluded — for PROSPECTIVE applicants, not enrolled students.

Other.caution: Reviewer bucket for valid-but-uncategorised student logins.

compliance_exclusion_blacklist._note: Case-insensitive substring match against the FULL final URL unless noted. `hard` = reject immediately, never judge. `soft` = reject unless another signal proves it is a student login. Applied AFTER client-side redirects are resolved, so a logout URL that lands on a login page is not lost.

cms_and_admin.reason: Site-admin backends, never a student login.

staff_faculty_hr.reason: Employee-facing, not the general student body.

alumni_career_jobs.reason: Alumni/donor and careers portals are not enrolled-student logins.

admissions.reason: For PROSPECTIVE applicants, not enrolled students.

webmail.reason: Generic/staff mail. Human review ruled these out as portals.

payment_gateways.reason: Third-party checkout, not an institution login.

publisher_database_sso.reason: Publisher platforms — not the institution's own login.

idp_metadata.reason: SAML entityID / metadata documents are machine endpoints, never a human login. Source: scripts/idp_denylist.txt.

auth_subpages.reason: Sub-pages of a login, not the entry point. NOTE: apply to the RESOLVED url — some systems bounce through /logout to reach /login (BUET's biis).

content_and_docs.reason: Manuals, help centres, news — describe a portal, are not one.

legal_pages.reason: Policy pages harvested alongside a portal.

social_appstore.reason: Social links and mobile-app deep links.

infrastructure_hosts.reason: CDN/WAF/PaaS hosts — a portal may sit behind them, but the root itself must never be whitelisted as a vendor.

not_student_login_vendors.reason: Multi-institution vendors that are not an enrolled-student login.

detail.jntuksdc.co.in: degree verification, not a student login
